title.narrative: Championing child-sensitive community social services to increase the resilience of China's vulnerable girls and boys

description.narrative: Overall objective: Reinforce capacities of Chinese CSOs and their role in social services delivery, social policy dialogue in partnership with local authorities. Specific objective: Pilot a child-sensitive, integrated, multi-sectoral and multi-stakeholder service model at the community level in Nanjing and Guizhou, by building CSO capacity to take part in, and inform, Chinas national child welfare and social protection system building.
